name: 16oz Kids Water Bottle with Straw Lid
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from premium food-grade plastic, this kids water bottle is lightweight, durable, and safe for daily hydration

- Designed with child-friendly materials, it is odor-resistant, reusable, and suitable for daily hydration needs.

- The secure flip-top straw lid, leakproof construction, and sturdy carrying handle make it a reliable companion for school, sports, travel, and outdoor activities.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed with the perfect size for children's daily hydration while remaining lightweight and easy to carry:

 - Height:  7.32 in ( 18.6 cm)

 - Diameter: 2.87 in ( 7.3 cm )

 - Capacity: ~16.2 oz (480 ml)

 

  • Printing Technology

- Personalized using DTF decal printing technology that produces vibrant colors, detailed, and high-resolution artwork.

- The design is printed directly onto the bottle surface, allowing for full-color customization with names, characters, illustrations, and unique artwork. 

- The durable print resists fading under normal daily use, creating a fun and eye-catching personalized accessory.

 

  • Functionality Use:

Perfect for a variety of everyday activities, including:

- School and preschool use

- Sports practice and outdoor activities

- Family trips and vacations

- Daycare and playdates

- Daily hydration at home or on the go

The bottle features a leakproof flip-top straw lid, detachable straw for easy cleaning, convenient push-button opening, and an integrated carrying handle for effortless portability. Each bottle also includes a surprise sticker sheet, adding extra fun for kids.

 

  • Care Instructions:

- To maintain the product’s quality and printed design, we recommend gentle hand cleaning only. 

-  Avoid using abrasive materials, dishwashers, or microwaves to preserve the ceramic finish and print durability.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized kids water bottle makes a practical and thoughtful gift for children. Ideal for birthdays, back-to-school season, Christmas, Easter, daycare gifts, school rewards, and other special celebrations. Customized with a child's name and favorite design, it becomes a unique keepsake that encourages healthy hydration habits every day.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x16oz Kids Water Bottle with Straw Lid and a sticker sheet
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
